title: НА + prepositional: This week, last week

blocks.text: НА + Prepositional indicates the week during which an event takes place.

items: the other day; within a few days

blocks.text: «The preposition НА + Prep. is used to indicate the week during which an event takes place.» «Note also the expression „на (этих) днях“. When referred to the past „на днях“ means „a few days ago“, „the other day“… When referred to the future, it means „within a few days“.»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.prompt: This week, temperatures will be negative.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Prep. is used to indicate the week during which an event takes place.» «Note also the expression „на (этих) днях“. When referred to the past „на днях“ means „a few days ago“, „the other day“… When referred to the future, it means „within a few days“.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.
